name: whetstone
description: The session-side half of Whetstone: the gate runs when an agent stops, and a strict path warns at the moment of the edit.

plugins.name: whetstone
plugins.description: Gates AI-written changes against a project's own definition of correct, and proves the verdict. Runs `wst gate` on Stop, warns before an edit to a strict path, and carries the init conversation as a skill.
